title: The colon takes up water and forms feces
summary: OpenStax says the colon absorbs water, forms feces, and is the organ that passes them out.
body: OpenStax says the main regions here are the cecum, the colon, and the rectum. The colon absorbs water and forms feces, and it is responsible for defecation. Bacteria there break down more carbohydrate residue and make certain vitamins. Mucus from the wall lets feces pass. This card is the water-and-feces job. It is not a treatment for constipation or infection.
